body: @Nainterceptor Any method that will change the number of pages will reset the current page to avoid inconsistencies. For example, if it was not the case we could stay on page 3 even though there were only 2 pages returned. So in fact, in your example `clearRefinements` `setQueryParameter` `addFacetRefinement` and `addDisjunctiveFacetRefinement` will set the current page to 0. You should call `setCurrentPage` when you want to change the current page.
